description: [OPERATOR] Issue a signed root AuthorityDelegationV1 (record_type aps:authority-delegation:v1, draft-03 section 3.1) from this server's key to a subject. This is the record revoke_delegation can revoke and check_authority_delegation can verify. Legacy create_delegation records cannot be revoked under SDK 8. Scope grants use the aps-hierarchical-v1 profile (for example commerce:checkout or commerce:*). Spend is bounded by default: give spend_unit, spend_per_action and spend_cumulative, or set spend_unbounded true. The record is tracked in this process's in-memory revocation store, which is lost on restart. Returns the signed record as JSON for the caller to keep and present. The issuer is always aps:ed25519:<this server's public key>. Holding the server key is the only authorization checked, so the tool is refused on a remote server (MCP_TRANSPORT=sse or MCP_REMOTE=1).

depth_remaining.description: How many further delegation hops the subject may create.

grants.description: Scope grants, aps-hierarchical-v1 profile, for example ['commerce:checkout'].

reversibility_ceiling.description: Most irreversible action class the delegation permits.

spend_cumulative.description: Most the whole delegation subtree may spend, as an integer in spend_unit.

spend_per_action.description: Largest single action, as an integer in spend_unit.

spend_unbounded.description: Set true to issue with no spend limit. Refused together with spend fields.

spend_unit.description: Exact-match accounting unit, for example iso4217:USD:minor.

subject.description: Identifier of the agent receiving authority, for example a DID or an agent id.

ttl_hours.description: Validity length from now, in hours.

values_required.description: Values floor identifiers the subject must hold, for example F-001.

name: issue_authority_delegation
title: Issue Authority Delegation
